---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a shared product capability or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## User and problem

Who experiences the problem, and what happens today?

## Desired outcome

What measurable operational result should improve?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the end-to-end journey, not only a screen.

## Scope and exclusions

What is included and explicitly excluded?

## Roles and permissions

Who can view, create, change, approve, export or delete?

## Data/privacy/security

What data is used, why, how long and how sensitive is it?

## Dependencies

Which shared services, modules, providers or customer systems are involved?

## Acceptance and telemetry

How will the team prove it works and measure value?
